info.title: Get in touch
info.body: Tell us a little about your space and screens, and we'll suggest the best way to get started.
info.responseTime: We reply within one business day.

checklist.title: What helps us answer in one go
items: How many screens, and whether they sit in one place or several
What goes on them: a menu, prices, offers, notices, a live dashboard
What the screens are, and whether there is already a player behind them
When you would like the first one running

info.enterprise: Above five screens the price is quoted for the size of the network. Send the number and we will send one back, rather than pointing you at a page that cannot know it.
info.selfServe: You do not have to write to us to start. The trial runs for 21 days with every feature switched on and no card, and pairing a first screen takes a few minutes. This page is for the questions a page cannot answer: a network across several sites, a screen in an awkward place, or a procurement process that needs a person on the other end.
info.answered: Before you write: what it costs and what is included are on the <pricing>pricing page</pricing>, and if the term itself is new, <whatIs>what digital signage is</whatIs> explains the whole thing from scratch. Those two answer most of what arrives in this inbox, and they answer it faster than we can.
